## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_火. Core element Fire, energy element Fire. Law: Fire and Fire are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Fire is this core's Body.

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 强火得土，方止其焰 (强而得制, the self pair).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Fire as the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill; the friction pole of Fire as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel, cure set Water (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, unrooted, excess, thin. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

spec.person: fully third person, no "you", no function claim, no persona
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry somewhere in it: Fire's material or Fire's (an arena noun, its verb, or either element as a common noun); the gate blocks without it; the base keeps its material by the ruling (the one surface with the arena, with the turns, the carries and the sign paragraph)

mechanism.base.value: Fire meets fire and neither has to fight the other for air, the old texts say: like lights shine on each other, and like seeks like. One flame set beside another takes nothing from it. Each feeds on what it was given and both grow brighter for the company, until the shared heat outruns what any single hearth can hold. Fire is the one element fed by its own kind and spent by it.

spec.notes: opens on a plain statement of the state in the reader's terms (Fire named, its volume in ordinary words, the reference lead-in "With too little Fire, …" or any plain statement, never "Run thin," or "Run heavy,"), then the elemental image of the state in one clause that stands alone, what it costs, then ONE plain directive that stands alone, the carry line below is cut from the image clause

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: With too little Fire, the flame runs on its own fuel with no second light to borrow warmth from, and the day costs more than it returns. Rest beside someone else's fire once a week.

spec.construct: THE THREE BEATS (owner 2026-10-14, D14, function first). Beat 1, the first sentence, is this function's fixed sentence, word for word: "Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on." (the function for anyone; the gate blocks any other first sentence). Beat 2, one sentence: what Fire makes of your Body, Fire as the agent with its plain verb or state (E7), ending on what that does to the function for this reader; no amount of Fire, no pole. Beat 3, one or two sentences opening on "Running thin,": what the shortfall does to the function, then the family's two drives as one either-or (the tension sentence, D9, both personas inside it, E8), the cost as the close (D11, the reader its subject). NEVER an amount of the element anywhere in the definition ("more Earth than", "little Water", "Metal to spare", "runs thin": the gate blocks them; the bars will carry the amount); never the old opener "{Element} is your {Function}, and as a …" (the title line above the definition already says it). Three or four sentences, 30 to 50 words.
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry anywhere in it as the energy's plain verb or state, or the energy's name in the mechanism sentence ("There is more Fire in you than you use"): Fire's or Fire's (flows, pours, settles; grows, builds, reaches; warm, light, fuel; holds, shelters, steady; hard, exact, finishes), or the body's own material (sleep, food, recovery, stamina, muscle, breath, rest); never a prop (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, branch, root, stream, flame, heat, burn are blocked and do not count); the element's name in the opener does not count; the gate blocks without it (owner 2026-09-30, narrowed 2026-10-14)
spec.opener: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on.
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (the gate blocks a definition without it)
spec.notes: the family's two drives in one either-or, one clause per persona with its cost, anchored in that persona's ruled domain words, in two or three sentences (no inventory, owner 2026-10-14, polish rule 4); the mechanism sentence is required in a definition and names Fire and its volume in ordinary words. The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

function.definition_friction.value: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire keeps it bright and quick. Running over, it spills into contests, so you would sooner be right alone than level with a peer or double a stake than share it. You win most days and pay in company.

spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Body is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: You treat rest as a loss and company as a crutch. Refuel on purpose: sleep before the second wind arrives. Eat with a peer once a week and let them pay. Ask one person for help on a job you usually do alone. Sit still for ten minutes a day.

spec.remedy_shape: THE REMEDY (owner 2026-10-14): the friction advice renders under its own title, THE REMEDY, after the ledger, and OPENS on the energy prescription beat: "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The beat is the first sentence of the field (the gate blocks any other opening); the one plain truth sentence and the two small life actions follow it, in the cure's register; the field closes on the last action, never on a second beat.
spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), two, in the cure's register (owner 2026-10-14, Q35: on an Order cure someone above you, a deadline, a judge, never a friend; on a Mind cure study, shelter, time; on an Action cure a thing made or shipped; on a Body cure sleep, food, rest; on an Expression cure a thing said or given), the smallest action last, closing on the energy prescription in the energy-manual register (owner 2026-09-29, the beat re-cut 2026-09-30): "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: Seek Water, the Order energy. Water runs cool and keeps to its banks, and a blaze meets it only on the water's terms. Let it shape what your Fire burns. You mistake being unstoppable for being well. Hand one project to a deadline someone else set. Ask the person above you which fire to put out first.

spec.pole_neutral: one verdict per pair, rendered on this page whichever pole the chart shows (this batch writes both poles), so it must read true on both: what Fire as your Body IS, never its state, no heavy, thin, too much, too little, running over, running short
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (noted on a verdict, the read decides)
spec.notes: explains "Fire is your Body": a behavioural truth with the reader as its subject plus ONE tendency-framed consequence beat, true on either pole, the tension inside the one sentence where it can be; at least eight words, no arena word, no turn word (but, yet, however), no more than two commas (owner 2026-10-14, v0.7.1)

cta_verdict.value: You are your own engine and your own company, so you do your best work beside an equal rather than under anyone's wing.
cta_verdict.value_b: You run on your own warmth more than on anyone's approval, so you tend to shine in company and go flat alone.
